hypotheses.statement: The new CSV writer library introduced in release 2.1.0 failed silently during the 2026-01-15 run, producing no output while returning exit status 0.
The upstream data extract for 2026-01-15 was empty or malformed, causing the job to process zero rows and write no output, while still exiting with status 0.

observed_facts.statement: Release 2.1.0 replaced the CSV writer library; the release record does not state whether the new writer signals failure by exit status.
No alerts fired for the reconciliation job or its host on 2026-01-15.
A reconciliation run for 2026-01-22 completed successfully, processing rows and writing an output file.
Finance reported the nightly reconciliation output for 2026-01-15 is absent, while files for every other date in January are present.
The scheduler reported the 2026-01-15 reconciliation run as completed successfully based on exit status 0 alone, with no check for output production.
Application logs for the 2026-01-15 run are unavailable due to seven-day retention.
There is no monitoring configured for this job (no output-produced check, duration check, or exit-status alert).
Upstream extract data for 2026-01-15 is unavailable for replay due to seven-day retention.
INC-1101 remains open with no root cause established; the missing output was regenerated manually from a downstream copy.
